decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool3' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.0511. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.131); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.611.
